title: Explicit parahoric-cuspidal orbital pairings for Levi-induced distributions over large-residue-characteristic p-adic fields
author: Jean-Loup Waldspurger
work: Représentations et quasi-caractères de niveau $0$ ; endoscopie
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.145
difficulty_reason: The definitions of parahoric cuspidal functions and Levi induction do not alone identify this orbital-distribution pairing or its exact volume factors. The author proves a constant-term calculation by facet segments and root-group cuspidal vanishing, then performs two nested coset decompositions with their Haar measures. Those geometric and measure comparisons produce the normaliser-indexed pairing, including its conjugation and the stated vanishing alternatives.
